title: Tensor normal form for two evaluation arrows
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting P and ordinary intrinsic unbounded categories D(P,T) of [def-pur-finite-proper-product-maps]. Let a:Y→B and b:Z→B be scheme morphisms, and choose sB:B→Spec(k) and sZ:Z→Spec(k). Take F,G∈D(P,B), H∈D(P,Y), J∈D(P,Z), and arbitrary arrows e:P_a F→H and d:P_b G→J. Pulling back mu_b followed by (1 tensor d), applying mu_t, and then (theta_a,b;P_r(e)) tensor 1 after comp_t,b equals pairEvaluation(e,d), with precisely the structural maps sB,sZ and t;sZ used in the construction. The statement retains all canonical source comparisons and does not involve direct image, exchange or projection. Here r and t are the two projections of Y×_B Z.

proof.text: Use naturality of the tensor comparison to move d through mu_t. Combine tensor maps by bifunctoriality. Use the canonical tensor composition identity for t and b. Expand theta and cancel comp_t,b against its inverse. The two remaining components are precisely those of pairEvaluation.

theorem finiteProductNormalForm (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ B) (b : Z ⟶ B)
    (sB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (sZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    (F G : D P B) (H : D P Y) (J : D P Z)
    (e : (pull P a).obj F ⟶ H) (d : (pull P b).obj G ⟶ J) :
    (comp P (pullback.snd a b) b).hom.app ((tensor P B).obj (F, G)) ≫
        (pull P (pullback.snd a b)).map
          ((mu P b sZ sB F G).hom ≫ (tensor P Z).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) d)) ≫
        (mu P (pullback.snd a b) (pullback.snd a b ≫ sZ) sZ _ J).hom ≫
        (tensor P (pullback a b)).map (Prod.mkHom
          ((theta P a b).hom.app F ≫ (pull P (pullback.fst a b)).map e) (𝟙 _)) =
      pairEvaluation P a b sB sZ F G H J e d
